comparison.objective: Set and lock a robot-gripper opening limit versus measure a sprung training doll on an infantometer.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds a screw during jam-nut tightening; the infantometer task holds four sprung leg joints straight while sliding a footboard to both soles.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked 90° return over cycles; the infantometer checks a valid crown-to-footboard measurement retained after both arms release.
comparison.reason: Both resist a physical restoring reaction, but the mechanisms, manipulation, and observable outcomes differ materially.
